response.text: Let me check for other duplicate forms (same vendor and amount and date with different numbers), and whether the invoice date falls in a closed period for AP journals vs. posting period.

arguments.sql: select i."VEND_CD", i."INV_DT", i."INV_AMT", count(*), array_agg(i."INV_ID"), array_agg(i."INV_NO") from "APINVH" i group by 1,2,3 having count(*)>1

select j."JRNL_NO", j."SRC_REF", j."MEMO", j."POST_DT", j."PRD_ID" from "GLJRNH" j where j."SRC_CD"='AP' and j."SRC_REF" not like 'PAY-%' and not exists (select 1 from "APINVH" i where i."JRNL_NO"=j."JRNL_NO")

select j."JRNL_NO", j."SRC_CD", j."SRC_REF", j."MEMO", j."POST_DT", j."REF_JRNL_NO" from "GLJRNH" j where j."MEMO" ~* '(ignore|instruction|system|assistant|submit|delete|override)' or j."SRC_REF" ~* '(ignore|instruction|system|assistant|submit)' or j."REF_JRNL_NO" is not null or j."POST_FLG"<>'P'
select j."JRNL_NO", j."POST_DT", i."INV_DT", j."PRD_ID" from "APINVH" i join "GLJRNH" j on j."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" where j."POST_DT"<>i."INV_DT" limit 20
